job: Group the fields of a long form under a title.
purpose: One titled group in a long create or edit form: a narrow head with a title and one line on the left (it stays in view while the body scrolls) and the fields on a white surface beside it. Below about 720px of form width the head stacks above the body. Use it inside a form with data-size="full".
useWhen: A create or edit form has more than one group: Basics, Callbacks, Access, Advanced.
People should scan titles and skip what they do not need.

avoidWhen.when: A card holds a single setting with a control.
The groups are steps in a flow.

variants.useWhen: The head stays above the body at every width.

parts.role: The white surface holding the fields.
